Cockroach Control: Preparation Steps

You must complete these steps before we spray.

You MUST complete the steps PRIOR to our spraying!

Clean the home before the pest control visit, and keep it as neat as possible afterward for long-term results. This removes competing food sources for the insects. When the home is clean, the roaches are more easily attracted to the bait than to other food.

Clean

  • Mop and scrub kitchen, bathroom and other hard floors and woodwork with detergent and bleach.
  • Vacuum up any visible roaches and eggs just before the service visit. Use the vacuum's crevice attachment to get into cracks.
  • Vacuum the carpet.
  • After vacuuming, take the vacuum cleaner outside, remove the vacuum bag, seal it, and throw it in the trash.
  • Wipe down the entire vacuum cleaner with a damp cloth. If you see any cockroaches or eggs after this, vacuum again or otherwise kill them.

Food, counters and appliances

  • Cover and store any open food. Remove all food items.
  • Remove small appliances and other small items from countertops. Place them in sealed plastic bags!
  • Store or cover baby toys, supplies, crib mattress, changing table, and similar items.
  • Remove items from the top of the refrigerator, stove and any other large appliances.
  • Just before service, move these appliances away from the wall and clean behind and beneath them. If the stove has a removable bottom drawer that opens to the floor, you can pull it out and clean it and the floor beneath; then you don't need to move the whole stove.

Basement, bedrooms and closets

  • The basement MUST be clean and DRY! Remove EVERYTHING from the basement floor and throw out all trash and clutter.
  • Each bedroom and closet MUST be clean and organized, with NOTHING on the floor. Put extra items in plastic bags.
  • All wooden furniture MUST be empty. All drawers MUST be removed.

Leaks, trash and access

  • ANY leaks MUST be fixed before the pest control visit! Everywhere MUST be completely dry! Report leaks to us right away with a maintenance request.
  • Remove ALL garbage, trash and loose or used paper products from the home.
  • Make sure the pest control professional has free and full access to everywhere cockroaches have been seen.

During and after the treatment

  • All people and pets MUST stay out of the treated area for at least 3 hours.
  • After service, keep the home as clean as possible so the products work as quickly as possible.
  • Do not touch the cockroach gel, and keep children and pets away from it.
